D: Size of the core now, across
D_0: Size of the core before the collapse, across
M_J: Jeans mass: the least mass that can collapse at a given temperature and density
M_odot: Mass of the Sun, the solar mass
P_0: Time for one turn before the collapse
P_spin: Time for one turn of the shrinking core
f: Shrink factor: the size before divided by the size after
n: Number of gas particles per unit volume
r: Distance of orbiting gas from the young star
